body:
[A10] The AEM store self-test failed on the deployed one-map model and was absent from CI. This change repairs its fixtures and cause-specific refusals, then adds the self-test to the pinned documentation workflow.

## Contents

- [Status](#status)
- [Linked Issue / roles](#linked-issue--roles)
- [Description](#description)
- [Authoritative references](#authoritative-references)
- [How to get into the same state](#how-to-get-into-the-same-state)
- [How to validate](#how-to-validate)
- [Known limitations / out of scope](#known-limitations--out-of-scope)
- [Definition of Done](#definition-of-done)

## Status

Head `a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3`, tree `31ddc6b5615ff91ceed7a6b52afca61c5fb9653d`, `464-aem-store-selftest` -> `dev`. The complete 41-command static/builder bank and five native groups pass on this exact object. It merges author head `1576f0893ae9781074fffb105f5384fe774ff11e` with dev `88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896`, preserving the complete issue patch. Trusted act, hosted checks and independent reviews are pending. Public evidence is in the validation comment.

## Linked Issue / roles

Closes #464
Relates to #407, #495 and #509

Executor: A167 (Opus); manager: A10. Cleared-context internal reviewer: R235 (Opus); external reviewer: R236 (Codex).

## Description

The self-test still indexed a second map after the deployed model changed to one map. Its new explicit fixture supplies valid input/output map geometry, and each negative vector must fail for its own bound. The six recorded deployed deviations retain their exact mapping values and are reindexed to AUDIO_MAP[0]. Python 3.12 also needs the missing `Callable` import.

The retained self-test has 20 arms, including fixture acceptance. All prior refusal, directory and format controls remain. The documentation carrier gains a pinned self-test step, with matching `ci_events.py` ownership and documentation. No production validator is widened.

The PP (protocol processor) serves the guarded descriptor image. Author comparison of all five shipping configurations found 83 generated product files byte-identical to the base. That evidence belongs to author head 1576f089; the later integration changes only the disjoint #507 Markdown tooling. Processor pins remain unchanged.

## Authoritative references

- [Issue scope and readiness](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/464#issuecomment-5770832953), [author assignment](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/464#issuecomment-5774939905), and [exact candidate publication decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/464#issuecomment-5776427479).
- REQUIREMENTS REQ-VER-03/04; IEEE 1722.1-2021 sections 7.2.13, 7.2.16 and 7.2.19; Milan v1.2 sections 5.3.3.9 and 6.4, as cited by `avdecc/aem_maps.py`.
- `docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md`, including the #407 carrier-script pin contract.

## How to get into the same state

```sh
git fetch origin 464-aem-store-selftest dev
git checkout a769d9dbc937fb324c4726e60dee5b2f7ad349e3
git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor
```

Use the documented toolchain and dependencies in `docs/testing/RUNNING_TESTS.md`.

## How to validate

```sh
python3 avdecc/gen_aem_store.py --self-test
python3 scripts/ci_events.py --check
python3 scripts/ci_events.py --selftest
python3 scripts/check_py_idiom.py
python3 scripts/check_em_dash.py --base 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896
python3 scripts/docs_check.py
python3 scripts/check_doc_paths.py
python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --check
python3 sw/builder/test_builder.py
```

Expected: 20 self-test arms pass; cause-specific refusals remain named; CI policy accepts the added pinned step and refuses its planted rewrites; documentation and idiom gates pass. The complete commands, native results and original/corrected mutation controls are linked in the evidence comment. Builder calibration gate 11 remains NOT RUN without its physical report.

## Known limitations / out of scope

The fixture's static input map tests a supported generator shape rather than the shipping dynamic input map. Changing a refusal message requires updating its fail-closed expectation. The pre-existing unused `avdecc/aem_rom.json` drift is tracked on #495; #509 retains descriptor-ownership decisions. No physical, bitstream, four-state or timing evidence is claimed. Four optional field-campaign skips contribute zero checks.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Scoped implementation and focused failure-sensitive controls are complete.
- [x] Full local bar passes on the exact current-candidate object.
- [x] Documentation reflects the changed self-test and CI step.
- [ ] Trusted act and required hosted contexts pass at the final head.
- [ ] Two independent positive reviews and reviewer-owned clean five-lens coverage.
- [ ] No open blocking/minor finding or review round remains.
- [ ] Validate against then-current dev and verify the actual merge result.
- [ ] Post-merge containment, hosted checks, Issue closure and Project Done.
title: Repair and run the AEM store generator self-test in CI
